title: Things that make sense: cold nights
caption: Cold nights have a system: blankets, soup, and one Capricorn carrying a spare scarf just in case. Who in your life always has the extra layer?

title: How Aries loves in winter
caption: Aries, you're first out the door when the snow hits, and that energy is a gift. Just warm their hands before you race the hill. Love goes best at a pace you share.

title: The first snow
caption:
The first snow, and your best friend suddenly looks different.
Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: a crush on a friend is allowed.

title: Aries Made a Group Chat
caption: Aries made a group chat at 6 AM, asked for crush advice, then acted before anyone finished typing. Who's the Aries of your group chat?

title: How do I slow down when I really like someone?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/01 - How do I slow down when I really like someone- (naske01).mp4
caption: Liking someone fast is not a problem. Let the plans grow one date at a time, and ask what pace feels good to them too.

title: Who texts back first
caption:
Be honest: is your sign replying in seconds or still drafting?
We ranked all twelve. Fast or slow, a kind reply is what counts.

title: Things that make sense: texting
caption: A proofread "on my way.", three voice notes in a row, and a "home safe?" at 11 PM that gets a yes in two seconds. Which texter are you?

title: Leo × Capricorn: the spotlight and the schedule.
caption: Wanting to be seen and wanting to be home by nine can share one night. Say the compliment out loud, respect each other's limits, and give the spotlight a time slot.

title: Who do you tell first
caption:
Who do you tell first when something good happens?
Cancer just found out the answer. Moonlight Lane, Ep 1.

title: Sag Has the Password
caption: Sag got the password and immediately banned small talk. Dinner is now a night hike. Breadsticks are allowed. Which rule would you break first?

title: Born on the cusp: am I both signs?
caption: Born near the line between two signs and never sure which one you are? The Sun is in one sign at your birth minute, and your Moon and rising add the rest. You were never half of anything.

title: They turn every walk into a race.
caption:
Your date turns a winter stroll into a sprint. Dealbreaker or not?
Not even close. Race to the corner, then slow down together.

title: Things that make sense: first dates
caption: Leo shows up with a compliment loaded, Sag swaps dinner for a walk, and Libra picks the place in one second because Libra asked what you like first.

title: Date 1 with a Fire sign: what to ask
caption: First dates feel like interviews when every question is about plans and jobs. With a fire sign, ask what excites them right now, then really listen. Save this for date one.

title: Aries, when the date gets moved
caption:
They moved the date. Aries, put down the "fine."
A new day isn't a no. Thursday still counts.

title: The first cold night
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Season 14- Cuffing Season/01 - The first cold night (nc14e01).mp4
caption: One cold night and suddenly all twelve signs are taking blanket applications. The stars have a better question than who's free all winter. Who in your group chat started cuffing first?

title: Name the pause.
caption:
When a fight gets too hot, it's okay to step away. Just say how long and that you're coming back.
Twenty minutes apart can save the whole conversation.

title: POV: you're dating an Aries.
caption: Dating an Aries: you say maybe, they're already outside. Fast to the corner, patient at every crossing.

title: Things that make sense: party season
caption: Party season, sorted: Aries opens the dance floor, Gemini knows every name by nine, and Capricorn has both coats ready the second you say you're tired.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: First Snow
caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: the first snow falls on the lane, and Cancer realises their best friend is the first person they want to tell everything. Crushes on friends are normal. Going quiet isn't the answer; showing up is.

title: First Snow Text
caption:
Your crush texts "it's snowing!!" and you freeze. Reply now or play it cool?
Neither. Send a snow photo back. Being happy to hear from them is allowed.

title: Minneapolis: never going outside
caption: Virgo found a way to cross a whole city without touching snow, and somehow also without meeting a single person. Which sign in your life packs the backup map?

title: The Question at the Party
caption: That moment at the party when someone asks if you're seeing anyone. You don't owe a long story: "not right now, and I'm happy" is enough. Then ask about their year.

title: Aries plans ice skating at 7 AM
caption:
Would you go ice skating at 7 AM for someone?
Aries did laps. The date held the wall. Then Aries came back for their hand.

title: Aries' holidays
caption: Aries in 2016 opened every gift by 5 AM, including the ones with someone else's name on them. Aries in 2026 sits on its hands and lets you go first. Growth looks like vibrating quietly.

title: The friend who went quiet
caption: When a friend goes quiet, it is easy to assume it is about you. Often it isn't. Send a check-in with no homework attached: thinking of you, no need to reply.

title: Who handles a late date better?
caption:
Your date says they're running 10 minutes late. Do you pace or order a pastry?
Ten minutes is just pastry time.

title: Things that make sense: love languages
caption: Taurus pushes the biggest snack your way. Aries wins the race to the car, then holds the door. Virgo fixes the squeaky door and never mentions it. Which one have you dated?

title: How Taurus loves in winter
caption: Taurus, your love looks like blankets, soup and slow Sundays. The coziest thing you can do this winter is scoot over and make room for them on the couch.

title: Aries, first snow, 3 AM idea
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/3 AM in Winter/01 - Aries, first snow, 3 AM idea (n3ae01).mp4
caption:
First snow at 3 AM and you want to text them right now?
Invite them for tomorrow. The snow will wait.

title: Unpopular opinion: plans are romantic
caption: Capricorn said planning a date is romantic and the crowd gasped. Then Sagittarius pulled out a colour-coded planner. Team spontaneous or team Saturday at seven?

title: They love new things. I love my routine.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/02 - They love new things. I love my routine. (naske02).mp4
caption: Your routine is allowed to be your comfort. Try a trade: one old favorite, one new thing. Small yeses count.

title: Hiding behind a croissant
caption:
Ever hidden from someone you like? Behind a croissant?
Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: why vanishing never helps.

title: The RSVP Poll Has No "No"
caption: Libra's party poll had three ways to say yes and zero ways to say no. Version two fixed that. Who in your chat needs a "no (totally fine!)" button?

title: How Gemini loves in winter
caption: Snowed in, Gemini? Twenty texts can't do what one call does. Send the message, then dial. Let them hear you laugh.

title: Winter starter pack: Aries
caption:
Aries in winter: shorts in the snow, snowball already thrown.
The rare item? Letting someone else win for once.

title: Aries asks in October energy
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Season 14- Cuffing Season/02 - Aries asks in October energy (nc14e02).mp4
caption: Aries skipped hello and went straight to a sign that says WINTER WITH ME?, in a T-shirt, in the snow. Same fire, a little slower. Ever been asked out at full speed?

title: Gemini × Cancer: the plans and the soup.
caption: Big plans and a quiet night in don't have to compete. Ask one question and hear the whole answer, and say "I miss you" instead of hinting it. Save this for your next cozy weekend.

title: Your side first
caption:
Ever watched someone scrape a windshield very, very slowly?
It was clearing your side first.

title: Unpopular opinion: "I'm not sure yet"
caption: Libra climbed onto a crate to defend "I'm not sure yet" and somehow Taurus ended up in tears. An honest maybe beats a rushed yes.

title: Why does the Moon change shape?
caption: Pisces thought a thin Moon meant a sad Moon. Half of it is always lit; we just see it from a new angle each night. A quiet week in love isn't the end of the story either.

title: A hand-knitted hat
caption:
A lumpy hand-knitted hat, reviewed without a single word.
Dropped stitches, zero complaints. Made by them wins.

title: The Packing List
caption: Packed a passport and a whole tent for a first date, then realized all you really need is one good question. Who in your life overpacks for feelings?

title: Date 2 with a Fire sign: reading it
caption: Second-date nerves love counting reply times. Look at effort instead: did they plan something, and did they talk you up? Fire signs show interest out loud.

title: Pisces cries about a note in their coat
caption: Found a note in your coat that just says "thought of you today"? Pisces is on tissue five. Small words on paper carry big love.

title: Montreal: the underground crush
caption: Cancer heard 'underground city' and moved in emotionally. It took one Bonjour-hi to bring them back up. Who's the friend you have to coax out of the tunnel?

title: Curious first.
caption: It's tempting to walk into the make-up talk with your whole case ready. Try one question first: what was that like for you? Listening opens more doors than winning.

title: Who plans the date
caption:
Who in your relationship actually plans the date?
All twelve signs, ranked. The best plan is taking turns.

title: Taurus' holidays
caption: 2016 Taurus guarded the cookie plate under a blanket. 2026 Taurus bakes a whole tray for your family first, and one spare, obviously. Who in your life is a cookie hoarder turned cookie sharer?

title: Decorating for One
caption: Decorating when it's just you can feel a little pointless. It isn't. You're the one who lives there, so make it cozy for you first.

title: Your date is rude to the server.
caption:
Your date snaps at the server. Cute dinner, or a warning?
How someone treats the person bringing the food tells you a lot.

title: Unpopular opinion: the same movie again
caption: Taurus says rewatching the same comfort movie is a perfect date. Ten seconds later the whole crowd was on the couch. What's the movie you'd rewatch forever?

title: Check-in, not a quiz
caption: Six questions in a row can feel like a test, even when they come from love. Ask one soft question, then let the quiet do some of the work. Save this for the next time you're worried about a friend.

title: Taurus, when they pick a new restaurant
caption:
Taurus, they picked somewhere new and the menu is all question marks.
Try it. Your usual will still be there on Friday.

title: Sag Is Planning a Surprise
caption: Sag's surprise trip plan was "vibes" and a 5 AM flight. One question to their person saved it. Do you love surprises, or love being asked first?

title: I lose interest after the first few dates.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/03 - I lose interest after the first few dates. (naske03).mp4
caption: The first spark always changes shape. Sometimes bored just means not curious yet, so bring a deeper question to date four.

title: POV: you're dating a Taurus.
caption: Never reach for a Taurus's cake. They might have ordered your own slice before you even asked.

title: Taurus builds the blanket fort first
caption: Taurus built a five-star fort with a snack shelf and forgot to invite anyone into it. One text fixed that. Who would you send the fort invite to?

title: How Cancer loves in winter
caption: Cancer, you're the one with the cocoa, the extra blanket and the hand-knit socks. This winter, let someone bring the mug to you. Being cared for counts too.

title: The Borrowed Scarf
caption:
They lent you their scarf. Is it a promise or just a scarf?
You won't know by guessing. Ask what it means.

title: Says sorry without a "but"
caption: Door 1 and Aries already swatted the "but" right out of the room. An apology with no fine print hits different. Who taught you to say sorry and stop there?

title: Taurus × Aquarius: the usual and the unusual.
caption: Loving the familiar isn't boring, and loving the new isn't flaky. Keep one ritual, try one new thing, then make a tradition that belongs to just the two of you.

title: I've got it
caption:
Do you say 'I've got it' even when you don't?
Sagittarius, carrying a tower of lanterns alone. Moonlight Lane, Ep 2.

title: Unpopular opinion: early nights
caption: Virgo, in a nightcap, defending the home-by-ten date. Even Sagittarius yawned and agreed. Early nights are underrated and we will not be taking questions.

title: How Leo loves in winter
caption: Leo, you warm up every cold room you walk into. The loving move is saving the best seat by the fire for them. Shine beside them, not over them.

title: Taurus plans a soup crawl
caption:
Four soups in one night: dream date or too much?
Taurus saw their date was full and packed the rest to go. No fuss.

title: Honest to a Fault
caption: Sagittarius will tell you the jacket is a lot. Sagittarius will also tell you to wear it, because you look that happy in it. Tag your honest-but-sweet friend.

title: Why is a half moon called a quarter?
caption: A half-lit Moon is called a quarter because it's a quarter of the way around its orbit. Halfway through anything, a date, a season, a year together, is a lovely time to ask how it's going.

title: Who handles meeting the friends better?
caption:
Meeting their friends for the first time? One sign learns every name, one brings cookies.
Curious beats perfect, every time.

title: Unpopular opinion: "what are we?"
caption: Scorpio calmly says asking "what are we?" isn't scary, and the crush in the crowd raises a hand. Would you ask first, or wait to be asked?

title: Date 3 with a Fire sign: saying what you want
caption: Hinting for weeks is exhausting for both of you. By date three, say what you're looking for and ask what they want. Either honest answer is a good one.

title: Who cries at the movie
caption:
Which sign cries at the movies? Spoiler: more than one.
Twelve signs ranked by tears. A soft heart is a strong one.

title: Boston: the parking-spot chair
caption: Aries thinks a lawn chair can reserve anything, including a skate date with someone they haven't met. Spoiler: you just ask. What's the pettiest thing you've ever saved a spot for?

title: How do I let them take care of me?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/04 - How do I let them take care of me- (naske04).mp4
caption: If you are always the one tucking everyone in, let some of that care come back. When they offer, try just saying thank you.

title: They talk through the whole movie.
caption:
They narrate every scene of the movie. Annoying or adorable?
Pause it, swap theories, then press play. That counts as a date.

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: telling the friends
caption: Gemini went from "met someone… anyway" to a thirty-slide presentation. The friends already had a banner made. The group chat always knows first.

title: Retire "always".
caption: "You always" and "you never" turn one hard night into a trial. Name the moment and how it felt instead. Small and specific is so much easier to fix.

title: Gemini, when you're both mid-story
caption:
Gemini, are you both telling a story at the same time again?
Let them finish. Your "no way!" lands better after.

title: Gemini's holidays
caption: Three parties, one night, zero real conversations. Then Gemini found one couch and one person and the clock just kept jumping. Are you a three-parties person or a five-more-minutes person?

title: The Couples Photo
caption: Ever end up holding the camera because everyone else came as a pair? You're not the extra in the picture. Set the timer and get in the shot.

title: POV: you're dating a Gemini.
caption: Dating a Gemini: three stories, no endings, five new nicknames. Then every tangent turns out to be about you.

title: Leo Pinned It Again
caption: Leo pinned its own message again, then learned "when can I see you again?" counts as a compliment. Twice, even. Which sign pins its own wins?

title: December is hard for some friends
caption: Not everyone loves this month, especially in a year when someone is missing. You don't have to fix it. Ask if they want company or quiet, and make room for both.

title: The Plus-One
caption:
The party invite says "plus one?" Who do you bring?
Not someone to impress the room. Bring someone who'd actually enjoy the night.

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: meet the family
caption: Cancer slipped an extra plate onto the table "for a friend". Turns out Mom set that place ages ago, cushion and all. Who's bringing someone home this year?

title: Aries × Virgo: now, and nearly ready.
caption: When one of you is already in the car and the other is still checking, a little notice goes a long way. Give a heads-up, let "good enough" be enough, and plan it together.

title: Gemini plans a bookshop swap
caption:
You each pick a book for the other. What would yours be?
Gemini picked nine. Their date picked one, and it was perfect.

title: Gemini's three almost-dates
caption: Three maybes, one Friday, one very dizzy Gemini. Two kind no's and a real yes later, Friday got a lot calmer. Tag the friend who says maybe to everything.

title: How Virgo loves in winter
caption: Virgo, the scarf, the gloves and the backup scarf are all love, and they notice. Add one more thing to the list this winter: tell them how you feel, out loud.

title: Who plans a first date better?
caption:
Spotlight and a banner, or plan A, B and a laminated C?
The best first date has their favourite thing on it.

title: Asks how the big thing went
caption: Taurus put your interview on the fridge and texted the minute you walked out. Remembering the date is cute. Asking how it went is the flag. Who always checks in after your big day?

title: Why is the Moon out in the daytime?
caption: Leo wanted the sky to itself, but the Moon is up in daylight on lots of days. If the Moon is feelings, they don't clock out at sunrise. Say the soft thing at noon, not only at 2 AM.

title: Three no's
caption:
Three offers of help. Three no's.
Why is yes, thank you so hard? Moonlight Lane, Ep 2.

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: "I like you"
caption: Aries tried "you're cool, I guess", then a giant banner, then finally put both down and said it quietly, face to face. Guess which one worked.

title: What if they don't like my friends?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/05 - What if they don't like my friends- (naske05).mp4
caption: First hangouts are awkward for everyone. Ask what felt off and listen first. You do not have to choose; let your worlds blend slowly.

title: Taurus, 3 AM toast, too comfy to date?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/3 AM in Winter/02 - Taurus, 3 AM toast, too comfy to date- (n3ae02).mp4
caption:
Ever lie awake wondering if you're too comfy to date?
Cozy alone is a great place to choose from, not hide in.

title: Sag's Itinerary
caption: Day 1: wake up. Day 2: figure it out. Turns out the real plan was saying the scary thing out loud. Planner or winger, which one are you?

title: How Libra loves in winter
caption: Libra, you could plan the prettiest winter walk in your sleep. Try handing them the map this time. Letting them choose is its own kind of romance.

title: Winter starter pack: Taurus
caption:
Taurus in winter means the heaviest blanket and soup since noon.
The sweetest part: they save you the warm spot.

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: the group photo
caption: Libra takes everyone's holiday photo and never ends up in one. This year the friends pulled them into the frame. Who's the photographer in your group?

title: Date 1 with an Earth sign: what to ask
caption: Rapid-fire questions can feel like a quiz. Earth signs open up when you slow down and ask about real comforts, like their perfect slow Sunday. Let the pauses breathe.

title: Built you in snow
caption:
When your Aries builds the worst snowman you've ever seen.
Turns out it was a portrait. Of you.

title: Denver: love at the summit
caption: Sagittarius went looking for love on a mountaintop while the cozy one was waiting in town with cocoa. Tag the friend who always needs a summit.

title: Libra × Capricorn: the romance and the agenda.
caption: Romance and routine can live on the same page. Add one small gesture for no reason, make the choice when it's yours to make, and put love on the calendar on purpose.

title: A homemade snow globe
caption:
Scorpio reviews a homemade snow globe, silently.
One shake, two tiny stars inside, and no composure left.

title: The Four-Minute Voice Note
caption: Pisces sent a four-minute voice note, Gemini wrote the transcript, and the date passed a napkin. Who in your chat sends voice notes this long?

title: Say it back.
caption: Nodding while you load your reply isn't listening. Before you answer, say back what you heard and check you got it right. Feeling heard comes before fixing anything.

title: Pisces cries about the lights coming on
caption: When the whole street lights up one house at a time and you are suddenly very emotional. Let the little beautiful things land.

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: the nickname
caption: Capricorn tried "hey… you", then a cake iced MY SWEETPEA, then simply asked what they like to be called. The answer was sweeter than the cake.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: The Market Stall
caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 2: the holiday market opens, and Sagittarius will not let anyone help. Not even Cancer. Letting someone hold the ladder isn't weakness. It's closeness. Practise saying yes, thank you.

title: Who says “I love you” first
caption:
Who says it first, and who schedules it for spring?
We ranked the signs. First or last, just mean it.

title: Cancer's holidays
caption: Cancer cooked for twenty and nobody asked how Cancer was doing. This year someone took the spoon and asked first. Tag the friend who always hosts and never sits down.

title: Soup for Everyone
caption: Looking after everyone is lovely, until you're eating crackers for dinner. This week, cook for yourself the way you cook for the people you love.

title: They kept the receipt from date one.
caption:
They saved the receipt from your very first date. Too much?
Keeping little things means they were paying attention.

title: Cancer has the soup ready
caption: Cancer made a whole pot of soup for someone it hadn't asked yet, then hid behind the counter when they walked by. Brave move at the door, though. What's your comfort meal?

title: The plan you can say no to
caption: The kindest invites come with an easy way out. Pyjamas welcome, leave whenever, no is totally fine. When saying no is easy, saying yes gets a little easier too.

title: Cancer, on date three (already named the dog)
caption:
Cancer, it's date three and the future dog already has a name.
The person across the table is right here. Start with them.

title: Sag Says It First
caption: Said 'I like you' at the café counter. It worked. Also, three muffins. Have you ever panic-ordered after a big confession?

title: Is there a dark side of the Moon?
caption: The far side of the Moon gets just as much sunlight; we simply never see it from here. Everyone you love has a side they haven't shown yet. Let them share it when they're ready.

title: POV: you're dating a Cancer.
caption: A Cancer packs snacks for a four-minute walk. On a rough day they don't try to fix it. They just stay close and listen.

title: Kind to the server
caption: Wrong drink, zero drama, a big thank you. Capricorn's checklist didn't stand a chance. How someone treats the server tells you plenty. Which sign is the nicest regular at your café?

title: I keep trying to fix their problems.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/06 - I keep trying to fix their problems. (naske06).mp4
caption: Sometimes they want a listener, not a fix. Ask whether they want advice or a hug, and follow their lead either way.

title: Shut out
caption:
When you keep turning down help, the people offering start to feel shut out.
Moonlight Lane, Ep 2.

title: Delulu or solulu: they laughed at my joke
caption: Two laughs and one "you're funny" and Leo had the meter pinned on delulu. Then Leo asked about Friday. What's the smallest sign you've ever over-read?

title: How Scorpio loves in winter
caption: Long nights and deep talks suit you, Scorpio. You don't have to open up all at once. Let them in one layer at a time, at a pace that feels safe.

title: Single in Cuffing Season
caption:
Cuffing season started and you're single. Panic-date or hide till spring?
Neither. Cozy counts with your friends, too.

title: Philadelphia: mixed signals, twisted
caption: Gemini's texts come with more twists than a soft pretzel. The fix was a plain sentence and a day of the week. Which sign texts in riddles?

title: Cancer × Sagittarius: the nest and the map.
caption: Missing home on the road is a real feeling, and so is wanting to go. Call when you get there, try one trip together, and bring a little of home along.

title: Cancer builds a pillow fort
caption:
A pillow fort, two mugs and one long talk. Yes or no?
The fort fell in on them. The talk kept going anyway.

title: Delulu or solulu: "see you around"
caption: "See you around" had Pisces planning a whole future, and crying about it, obviously. One brave question later, around means Saturday.

title: Date 2 with an Earth sign: reading it
caption: Calm can look like bored when you're nervous. Watch the details instead: they remembered your order, they found the thing you mentioned. That's how earth signs say they care.

title: Who handles a cancelled date better?
caption:
They cancel because they're sick. How long do you stare at the reply box?
Keep it simple: rest up, I'll be here.

title: The Secret Gift Exchange
caption: Capricorn wrote the rules, Gemini drew itself twice, and Taurus found the perfect gift by remembering cold hands. What's the best small gift you've ever gotten?

title: How Sagittarius loves in winter
caption: Sagittarius, you can pack for a snow trip in four seconds. Before you go, ask whether they want the adventure or the sofa. A good trip can wait a weekend.

title: Who remembers your coffee order
caption:
The sign that remembers your coffee order is a keeper.
All twelve, ranked. Little details are big love.

title: Delulu or solulu: we both like hiking
caption: Same trail, same snack, same sunrise photo, and Sagittarius had already called it fate. One question did more than fate ever could. Snacks are non-negotiable.

title: I say yes to every party. I'm exhausted.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/07 - I say yes to every party. I'm exhausted. (naske07).mp4
caption: A kind no is still kind: "I can't this time, but I'd love to soon." Rest makes you better company. Save this for the busy weeks.

title: They photograph every dessert.
caption:
The cake is getting a full photo shoot before anyone eats. Dealbreaker?
Let the dessert have its moment. Then they share the first bite.

title: Leo wants a winter photo partner
caption: Leo auditioned a snowman, a lamp post and a passing Sagittarius, and somehow every print was still just Leo. Then it turned the camera around. Who takes the best photos of you?

title: Why does the Moon look huge tonight?
caption: That giant Moon on the horizon is the same size as always; it's a trick of how our brains judge size. Big feelings can do that too. Take a breath and check their real size before you react.

title: Leo, when they didn't notice the haircut
caption:
Leo, did they not notice the haircut? Hints are quiet.
Say it out loud and let them get excited with you.

title: Sag Texts Back
caption: One careful paragraph from Scorpio. One 'yes!!' from Sag, two seconds later. Thursday is booked. Are you a fast replier or a careful drafter?

title: One fight at a time.
caption: A fight about the lights can turn into a fight about 2019 fast. Keep the old folders closed and solve tonight's thing together. Save this for the next tangle.

title: POV: you're dating a Leo.
caption: A Leo will stop posing in the mirror just to tell you that you look amazing. Then pull you into the frame.

title: Delulu or solulu: they held the door
caption: They held the door and Cancer was ready to bring out the family photo album. Then Cancer asked about coffee and got a real yes. Manners are a start, not a proposal.

title: Lights Walk, No Plus-One
caption: Seeing the lights on your own can feel strange at first. Go for the lights, not the photo. Want a picture? Just ask someone, then return the favour.

title: The Three-Week Gift
caption:
Three weeks in and the holidays are here. What's the gift?
Not a whole tree, not nothing. Something small and sweet says plenty.

title: Leo's holidays
caption: 2016 Leo spelled its own name in lights and blinded the whole street. 2026 Leo turns the spotlight around and points it at you. Still bright, just better aimed.

title: The cancelled-plans friend
caption: Third cancellation and the scorecard is already drafted. Skip it. Say how it felt once, kindly, then ask what's going on with them. Sometimes the answer is just: I'm overbooked.

title: Leo judges a gingerbread contest
caption:
Would you let a Leo judge your gingerbread house?
Leo built a castle, then gave the crown to the lopsided little house.

title: Packs a spare pair of gloves
caption: Sagittarius left the house without gloves, as one does. Cancer packed two pairs, as one does. Tag the person who always has a spare.

title: How Capricorn loves in winter
caption: Capricorn, you show love by shoveling their path before they're even awake. Don't slip away afterwards. Knock, and let them say thank you.

title: Scarf or sign
caption:
They lent you their scarf. It's been four days.
Is it a scarf, or a sign? Moonlight Lane, Ep 3.

title: Delulu or solulu: a follow-up question
caption: Aquarius read two follow-up questions as destiny, asked about a date, and got "as friends? I'd love that!" Still a win: now Aquarius knows, and it made a friend.

title: Leo × Pisces: the speech and the tears.
caption: Big personalities and soft hearts can take care of each other. Ask how they feel, tell them they did well, and let a few happy tears be part of the evening.

title: Who buys a gift on a budget better?
caption:
Tiny budget, big feelings. A day trip or a list of things they mentioned?
The best gifts prove you were listening.

title: Pittsburgh: which bridge?
caption: Libra can't pick a bridge in the city of bridges. The trick: take the one with someone kind (and a pierogi) on the other side. Which sign needs the longest to decide?

title: I hold grudges. How do I let go?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/08 - I hold grudges. How do I let go- (naske08).mp4
caption: Holding on can feel safe, and it is also heavy. Say what hurt, once, out loud. Then see if you are ready to set it down.

title: Gemini counts snowflakes, not sheep
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/3 AM in Winter/03 - Gemini counts snowflakes, not sheep (n3ae03).mp4
caption:
Can't sleep, so you think up every question for your crush?
Save them for coffee and ask one at a time.

title: Cancer Frames a Text
caption:
Cancer got a same-day reply and had it framed. Then someone remembered the talk with their mom, and the frame quietly hit the floor.
What tiny thing did you once treat like a proposal?

title: Date 3 with an Earth sign: saying what you want
caption: "Let's see where it goes" only works for so long. Tell them you like where this is heading and the pace you'd like, then ask for theirs. Clarity feels safe to an earth sign.

title: Winter starter pack: Gemini
caption:
Gemini's winter: three hats, two plans, one very busy group chat.
But when they listen, they remember every word.

title: Cancer's Year-End Dinner
caption: Cancer offered to cook for twelve, then admitted being tired at 1:12 AM. The chat claimed every dish in four seconds. Who's the Cancer of your friend group?

title: Is a blue moon actually blue?
caption: A blue moon is a calendar thing, not a colour, and it only comes around every few years. Kindness shouldn't wait that long. Small sweet things, often, are what people remember.

title: Found it
caption:
Why is there so much tape on one tiny present?
Because they kept looking for the thing you lost.

title: Leo Gets a Thumbs-Up
caption: One like on a photo and Leo is already thanking the academy. The person who saved a front-row seat at the recital, though? That's the real standing ovation.

title: How Aquarius loves in winter
caption: Aquarius, a snow robot that says hi is a very you way to flirt. Big gestures are fun, but sometimes all they want is a simple hello from you.

title: A calendar for next year
caption:
Give a Capricorn a calendar and watch the face.
The last page said: whatever you want, I'm in.

title: Virgo's cuffing spreadsheet
caption: Virgo's spreadsheet found a perfect 4/4 match and Virgo felt nothing. Then a Sagittarius tripped in with cocoa and the heart monitor went wild. Which column would you add?

title: Swap "or" for "and".
caption: Holiday plans can feel like a contest someone has to lose. Try asking how you can do both, kindly. Planning side by side beats a tug of war every time.

title: Pisces cries about a dog in a sweater
caption: A dog in a striped sweater. With a pocket. Pisces did not stand a chance. Delight is allowed to be this big.

title: Sag on the Couch
caption: Sag on movie night: body on the couch, brain on a mountain, a ferris wheel and a hot-air balloon. Then one question brought it home. Who's your 'where are you right now?' person?

title: The Day Off Plan
caption: A day off with a 37-step plan isn't really a day off. Rest doesn't need to be finished or checked. Pick one nice thing and let the rest wander.

title: Who's always running late
caption:
Find your sign on the always-late list.
Ranked from "five minutes" to arrived yesterday. A quick heads-up is the kind part.

title: Libra Gets Asked
caption: Being asked where to eat should not require a parade. Libra threw one anyway. Then Gemini booked the place Libra mentioned once, in July. Tag your listener.

title: Long-distance friends
caption: Different cities, different clocks, a lot of missed calls. A small ritual beats a perfect plan: one time, every week, kept. Who would you set a standing call with?

title: They laughed when you said no.
caption:
You said no and they laughed it off. Is that a red line?
Yes. A no is a whole answer, and the right person hears it the first time.

title: Virgo's holidays
caption: Virgo spent the 2016 party at the sink and missed the gift swap entirely. This year the dishes stayed dirty and Virgo stayed on the couch. Which one are you at a party: dancer or dish duty?

title: Scorpio × Gemini: the deep end and the shallow end.
caption: Deep questions and light jokes both have a place. Answer one question honestly, let a joke just be a joke, and take turns choosing how deep the talk goes.

title: Virgo, when the gift is almost right
caption:
Virgo, the scarf is lumpy and one end is longer. They made it themselves.
Love the thought first. Wear it anyway.

title: Lets you finish your story
caption: Leo had a thought, swallowed it, and asked what happened next. That's growth. Also, the goose had a scarf. Who in your life lets you get to the good part?

title: I said something too honest. Now what?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/09 - I said something too honest. Now what- (naske09).mp4
caption: Honesty matters, and so does how it lands. Go back, say "that came out wrong, sorry," then say what you meant, more gently.

title: The nine-card speech
caption:
Wrote a nine-card speech to return a scarf?
Cancer did, then hid in a snowbank. Moonlight Lane, Ep 3.

title: Virgo Grades a Text
caption: A period at the end of a text earned a gold star. Seven o'clock-ish earned an A+. A whole plan made for them? Virgo dropped the clipboard. Which grade would your last date get?

title: How Pisces loves in winter
caption: Pisces, crying at the first snowflake isn't too much. It's how you love. Bring that soft heart into winter and feel it all, out loud.

title: POV: you're dating a Virgo.
caption: A Virgo notices the onions you always pick out. They also keep the napkin you doodled a heart on.

title: Gemini, Three Replies at Once
caption: Gemini answered three questions in one bubble, then tried something new: one question and a real wait. Are you a one-question texter or a three-at-once one?

title: Why isn't there an eclipse every month?
caption: There's a new moon every month but no eclipse, because the Moon's path is tilted and usually slips past. Plot twists are rare. Most of love happens on ordinary days, so make those count.

title: Two Weeks Apart
caption:
They're going home for two weeks. Tag along or go silent?
Pick a call time you both like, then go enjoy your own people.

title: Aquarius Gets a Good Morning
caption: Aquarius commissioned a statue for a good-morning text. Fair. Then Sagittarius asked to hear the whole theory, all night, and the bar went straight to the ceiling.

title: Date 1 with an Air sign: what to ask
caption: Small talk about the weather rarely gets anyone excited. Ask an air sign something playful, like what class they'd teach, and follow wherever the tangent goes.

title: Virgo plans a spontaneous day
caption:
Can a spontaneous day come with an itinerary?
Virgo crossed out the plan the moment their date spotted a cosy café.

title: Anchorage: the long-night stare
caption: Scorpio treats the long winter nights like a staring contest, and the moose is winning. Turns out being seen beats being mysterious. Who's the most intense sign in your group?

title: Aries' holiday blind spot
caption: Aries, saying yes to every party for both of you comes from a good place. Their calendar is theirs, though. Ask first, then RSVP together.

title: Who says “I like you” first better?
caption:
Would you say it with a science-fair poster or a nine-page poem?
However it comes out, saying it is the brave part.

title: Taurus and the Last Dumpling
caption: Not sharing fries with someone who said they weren't hungry: valid. The slow stare over the last dumpling: a little petty. Missing your cozy night: valid, so say it out loud.

title: How do I relax on a date?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/10 - How do I relax on a date- (naske10).mp4
caption: You do not need a plan for every minute. Pick one thing to do and let the rest happen. The best part is usually the part you did not plan.

title: Who sends the good-morning text
caption:
Does your sign send the good-morning text, or the good-afternoon one?
Ranked. Saying it back is a small yes.

title: Libra can't pick between two scarves
caption: Libra spent half an hour on two scarves, then polled the group chat about two people and got a tie. Turns out it kept reaching for the same one all along. Are you a group-chat poller?

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: The Borrowed Scarf
caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 3: day four of keeping the borrowed scarf, and Cancer has a nine-card speech ready. A gift can't say what you mean. One warm, simple line can.

title: They can't pick a restaurant.
caption:
Twenty minutes later, still no restaurant. Dealbreaker or not?
Offer two choices. Indecisive hearts love a short menu.

title: Sag Throws a Party
caption: Sag invited everyone. Cancer quietly fed all of them. Every great party has a kitchen hero, so who's yours?

title: Aries × Pisces: the sprint and the daydream.
caption: Rushing to the finish can mean missing the best part. Slow your pace, say where you wandered off to, and notice the small moments together. Tag the friend who always stops for the lights.

title: Libra, when you said "no worries"
caption:
Libra, you said "no worries" and now the worries are piling up.
You're allowed to say it bugged you a little. Kindly counts.

title: Gemini Renames a Contact
caption: Saving them in your phone as Mr. Late is petty, and Gemini knows it. Wanting someone to ask about your day is not. Which one have you done this week?

title: Let the sorry land.
caption: Saying "it's fine" when it isn't keeps the hurt around. When someone apologises well, let it in: "thank you, I needed that." Receiving a sorry is part of the repair too.

title: POV: you're dating a Libra.
caption: Two people, one dessert, a Libra with a ruler. Split perfectly fair, then they slide you the extra bite.

title: Item Six
caption: Capricorn's agenda had six items. Item six was a date invite. Aquarius had been waiting since item one. Would your group chat have spotted item six?

title: Nobody to Ask
caption: No one around to ask which ornament looks better? You don't need a second vote. Start with what you like. Your taste has always been enough.

title: Too Cold to Go Out
caption:
Too cold to go out tonight, and you had plans.
Don't brave it in no coat, and don't cancel with "lol". Call and stay in together.

title: Hears "no" the first time
caption: "Not tonight." "Ok! Rest up." No sulking, no second ask, no guilt trip. Scorpio was ready for a negotiation that never came. What's the smallest no you wish people heard?

title: Nine Invites
caption: When every weekend in December fills up, it's easy to forget you're allowed to say no. Pick the gatherings you'd truly miss, send a warm note to the rest, and keep one day just for rest.

title: One warm sentence
caption:
Hoping a gift will say what you can't?
It won't. One warm sentence will. Moonlight Lane, Ep 3.

title: Scorpio's Dramatic Exit
caption: Scorpio remembers what you wore on date one, swept out of the room in a cape (to the kitchen), and still wants to know where this is going. Two out of three, honestly.

title: Taurus' holiday blind spot
caption: Taurus, your traditions are part of who you are. Theirs are too. This year, try one bite of their holiday and see what it adds to yours.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Aries at the holiday party
caption:
Who's the first one at the party, setting up chairs before the host is dressed?
Aries. And it starts the dance floor so nobody has to go first.

title: Aries vs Libra: Fastest Buzzer Loses
caption:
Aries buzzed before the question existed. Libra needed a minute to pick a flag. Somehow it ended in a tie, and the front row is still crying.
Who are you on game night: the buzzer or the ponderer?

title: Who checks on the checker?
caption: The friend who always listens rarely gets asked how they are. Turn the question around tonight, and then actually wait for the answer. Tag the friend who holds everyone up.

title: Yes to both
caption:
Two invitations for the same Saturday. You said yes to both.
Libra, this one's for you. Moonlight Lane, Ep 4.

title: Capricorn Sends Minutes
caption: Capricorn wrote meeting notes about a tiny argument and sent them. Petty, beautifully formatted. The real ask was simpler: please plan something for once.

title: Small Budget, Big Heart
caption: Worried your gift isn't big enough? The ones people keep are the ones that prove you were listening. Think back to something they loved this year and make it personal.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Taurus at the holiday party
caption:
Is your Taurus guarding the snack table again?
Look closer: it's saving the last cookie for you.

title: Vancouver: the snow globe that rains
caption: Taurus shook the snow globe and got rain, which feels very on brand for this city. Half an umbrella later, soup counts as a date. Who's your rainy-day sign?

title: Why does the Moon turn red in an eclipse?
caption: In a lunar eclipse the Moon sits in Earth's shadow, and a little red sunlight still bends in to reach it. Hard weeks can feel like that shadow. Let your people in; some light always finds you.

title: Libra plans a candle-scent date
caption:
Pick a candle that smells like the two of you. Easy?
Libra sniffed for ages. Their date chose in one second. It was perfect.

title: Libra's holidays
caption: Libra couldn't pick a gift in 2016, so it bought all six and buried its date in boxes. In 2026 it just asked what would make them feel loved, and wrote the answer down. Revolutionary.

title: I'm bad at saying how I feel.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/11 - I'm bad at saying how I feel. (naske11).mp4
caption: You do not need perfect words. "I like spending time with you" works. Say it once, and it gets easier after.

title: Who handles an awkward pause better?
caption:
The conversation goes quiet on a date. Staring contest or twenty questions?
A little quiet can be comfortable too.

title: Leo vs Sagittarius: Zero Inside Voices
caption:
Two fire signs, one stage, zero volume control. Sag won on honesty, and Leo still led the standing ovation.
Which fire sign do you want in your corner after a breakup?

title: Date 2 with an Air sign: reading it
caption: One short reply is not a verdict on the whole date. Listen for "we should go to..." instead. Air signs often flirt by planning the next time.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Gemini at the holiday party
caption:
Ever watched a Gemini hold four conversations at once?
The sweet part: it remembers every name and asks how the new job went.

title: Scorpio, all in or nothing
caption: Gemini said cocoa. Scorpio heard matching mittens, a shared calendar and a cabin. Deep is a gift, and it can still start with one sip. Who in your life goes all in?

title: Aries × Taurus: the spark and the slow burn.
caption: Fast and slow can share a table. Stay for dessert, say yes to one small surprise, and pack something warm so the slow one enjoys the adventure too.

title: Cancer knits a scarf after two dates
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/3 AM in Winter/04 - Cancer knits a scarf after two dates (n3ae04).mp4
caption:
Two dates in and already knitting them a scarf?
A scarf is warmth, not a promise. Give it lightly.

title: The Honest Toast
caption: Never hand Sag the mic. Every toast starts like a roast and ends with someone tearing up into their cocoa. Who would you toast first?

title: Gemini's holiday blind spot
caption: Three parties in one night is a lot of fun and not much time together. Gemini, pick one, stay till the last song, and stay where they are.

title: Winter starter pack: Cancer
caption:
Every Cancer owns a cookie tin and a mug for every friend.
And a spare scarf for whoever forgot theirs.

title: Sagittarius Posts a Quote
caption: The vague quote about freedom after a small bicker? Petty. Needing a night alone? Valid. Wanting your big plan taken seriously? Very valid, so tell them. Which sign posts the quote in your group chat?

title: The sorry is a start.
caption: Hearing the same sorry every week gets tiring. A sorry shows you see it; a small change shows you mean it. Pair the apology with one plan you can actually keep.

title: Pre-warmed
caption:
Your coat is being held hostage by the radiator.
Some people say I love you with a warm coat.

title: Puts the phone face down at dinner
caption: The phone buzzed. Libra flipped it over without looking and kept listening to Gemini's snow speech. Small move, huge energy. Phone on the table or in the bag at dinner?

title: Cancer's holiday blind spot
caption: Cancer, you host it all and eat last, and usually cold. The people at your table came to see you. Sit down, pass the plate and let yourself be a guest.

title: Party, bakery, party
caption:
Party, bakery, party, bakery.
Half of you in two places is all of you in neither. Moonlight Lane, Ep 4.

title: Aries Is Not Cold
caption: "I'm not even cold," says the Aries, shivering, clearly hoping for your jacket. Then they skip the act and just say it: I like you, a lot. Who's your shivering Aries?

title: Just for the Holidays
caption: When it's cold and quiet, a "just for the holidays" offer can sound tempting. Lonely isn't a reason to say yes. Say what you want, kindly, and wait for real.

title: A cookie of my face
caption:
What happens when you bake a Leo a cookie of its own face?
Too iconic to eat. Obviously.

title: Scorpio Is Typing…
caption: Scorpio typed for twenty minutes, sent "nvm", then sent the bravest sentence in the whole chat. Which sign takes the longest to hit send?

title: Show up with soup
caption: When a friend is sick, the best care asks nothing back. Leave the soup at the door, send one line, and let them rest without having to host you.

title: Pisces cries about “take your time”
caption: Typing, deleting, typing again, and they just say "no rush. take your time." Patience is a love language too.

title: Scorpio Says Fine
caption: When a Scorpio says fine, it has usually been thinking about it for nine hours. When it says interesting, it is obsessed. When it asks where you're going, believe it.

title: Plus-One Short
caption: Walking into a party of couples on your own can feel lonely for about five minutes. You're not missing a half. Go say hi to someone new, and maybe the host's dog.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Cancer at the holiday party
caption:
Brought homemade cookies and a backup tin, just in case?
That's Cancer, and it always finds the guest standing alone.

title: Milwaukee: the frozen photo shoot
caption: Leo posed on the frozen lake so long the smile froze in place. The one worth meeting asked what Leo actually likes. Which sign has a good side they defend?

title: Why does Saturn go backwards every year?
caption: Saturn isn't really going backwards; Earth is simply passing it. If a retrograde season has you looking back, use it gently: check that your plans and promises still fit the life you want.

title: Who apologizes first
caption:
Who says sorry first after an argument?
Twelve signs, ranked. Going first isn't losing.

title: Scorpio's holidays
caption: Scorpio solved the whole secret gift swap in 2016, out loud, in front of everyone. In 2026 it uses the same detective skills to remember the one thing you mentioned in spring. Scary. Romantic.

title: I cry at everything. Is that too much?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/12 - I cry at everything. Is that too much- (naske12).mp4
caption: Feeling deeply is not too much. The right person will not ask you to feel less. If you need words: "I'm okay, I'm just moved."

title: They lied about something small.
caption:
They told a tiny fib about a plant. Does small even matter?
It does. Little lies make it hard to trust the big things.

title: Taurus vs Scorpio: The Staring Round
caption:
Nobody blinked, nobody buzzed, and the host had to ask twice. Then Scorpio opened the vault, just a little.
Tag the friend who keeps every secret forever.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Two Invitations, One Night
caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 4: Libra says yes to a party and a midnight bake on the same night. Splitting yourself in half means nobody gets you. Choose, then tell the other person kindly and early.

title: Scorpio, when they say "I'm fine"
caption:
Scorpio, they texted "i'm fine" and your brain read it nine ways.
Ask once, gently. Then trust what they tell you.

title: Sag says "I'm not looking"
caption: Sagittarius is a free spirit on a solo trip with no ties, and somehow packed two mugs and two scarves. For balance. Which sign do you know is looking while saying they're not?

title: Aquarius × Cancer: the theory and the feeling.
caption: Feelings don't need a theory, just a sentence. Say what you feel in plain words, trust that time apart isn't a goodbye, and remember the simplest answer is often a hug.

title: POV: you're dating a Scorpio.
caption: That Scorpio stare across the table? Deep questions, zero small talk, and secretly just as nervous as you.

title: Sag's Mystery Match
caption: The blind mystery card said homebody. Sag said adventure. A blanket fort with the whole night sky on the ceiling said both. Staying in or going out tonight?

title: Date 3 with an Air sign: saying what you want
caption: You don't need a big speech to be honest. Tell them you like this, say there's no rush, and leave space for their answer. Light and clear goes a long way with air signs.

title: The Winter Playlist
caption:
They made you a winter playlist. How do you answer that?
Not with nine hours of your own, and not with "nice". Tell them the song you replayed.

title: Pisces Is Not Crying
caption: Pisces is not crying. Pisces is crying, because the song is nice. Pisces has also already imagined your whole winter together. Tell us you know a Pisces without telling us.

title: Leo's holiday blind spot
caption: Leo, the perfect holiday photo can take a while. They just wanted to be in it with you. Keep the blurry one where you're both laughing. That's the real one.

title: Scorpio’s midnight telescope date
caption:
Midnight, a telescope and a very quiet Scorpio.
The big mystery was the Moon, and the spot they go when they miss people.

title: Says "take your time"
caption: Forty pages of menu, one Taurus, and a Scorpio who never once sighed. Patience is a whole personality. Be honest: are you the menu reader or the one waiting?

title: I want to say "I love you" first.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/13 - I want to say -I love you- first. (naske13).mp4
caption: If you feel it, it is okay to say it. Say it without needing it back right away, and let their answer come in its own time.

title: I just wanted you here
caption:
'I just wanted you here.'
The cost of saying yes to everything. Moonlight Lane, Ep 4.

title: Capricorn Is Just Busy
caption: "Just busy this week" means Friday is already cleared for you. "Let's be practical" means the plant has a name. Capricorn's heart was never off the clock.

title: Social Battery: 2%
caption: If the party is loud and you're running on empty, you don't have to hide in the coat pile. Tell someone you're stepping out for ten quiet minutes, then come back when you're ready.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Leo at the holiday party
caption:
Your Leo just gave a speech nobody scheduled.
Then it handed the mic to the shy friend, and the whole room got warmer.

title: Aquarius Renamed the Chat
caption: Aquarius fixed a bike light and assumed that said everything. The chat suggested one more step: saying why out loud. Which sign shows love by fixing things?

title: How do 12 signs fit in one grid?
caption: Four elements times three modes makes twelve, and every sign is its own combination. Two people can share an element and still move at different speeds, so ask about pace instead of guessing.

title: Who handles a party where they know nobody?
caption:
Walking into a party where you know no one: snack table or take over the room?
You only need one friendly face to start.

title: Aquarius Is Not a Romance Person
caption: "Not really a romance person," says the Aquarius who drew you a star map by hand. Translation available on request. Which line has an air sign said to you?

title: What's under it.
caption: Sometimes the dishes are just dishes, and sometimes they're carrying a bigger feeling. Gently ask what it's really about. The real thing is usually easier to solve together.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Virgo at the holiday party
caption:
Straightened the garland twice before anyone noticed it was crooked?
Virgo also makes sure every single guest has a ride home.

title: Ottawa: skating to work
caption: Capricorn skates to work on schedule every day, right past the same cute face. Slowing down is allowed, Capricorn. Which sign would pencil in a crush?

title: Nobody Could Come
caption: Everyone bailed on the trip? You're good company too. Go anyway, see the thing, and send the view to the friends who couldn't make it.

title: Who gives the best hugs
caption:
Which sign gives the hug that feels like home?
We ranked all twelve. The best hugs start with a yes.

title: Virgo vs Capricorn: Clipboards Out
caption:
Two clipboards walked onto a game show. Virgo won by forgiving a forgotten coffee order, and Capricorn handed over a gold star like a true professional.
What's your coffee order, and does your person know it?

title: Good news, shared
caption: Hiding good news to protect a struggling friend can leave them out of something lovely. Friends can hold both. Share it gently and let them choose to celebrate with you.

title: They wrap gifts terribly.
caption:
Their gift wrap looks like a snowball made of tape. Problem?
Never. Lumpy paper, perfect thought inside.

title: Capricorn schedules a feelings meeting
caption: Capricorn sent a calendar invite titled FEELINGS with an agenda attached, then froze on the blank slide. The unscripted part went better. Would you accept this meeting?

title: Gemini × Capricorn: the jokes and the goals.
caption: Goals feel lighter when there's room to laugh. Take an afternoon off, show up when you said you would, and put a little play right on the plan for next year.

title: Sagittarius, booking a trip on date two
caption:
Sagittarius, the suitcase is packed and you met them on Tuesday.
Keep the ticket for someday. Enjoy date three first.

title: Ask Sag Anything
caption: Ask Sag anything and the answer is probably yes. Text first? Yes. Bring snacks? Obviously. Cry on a first date? Sag's bringing tissues. What would you ask?

title: Virgo's holiday blind spot
caption: Virgo, fixing the tree at midnight is very you. That crooked star might be the one they hung, though. Leave it. Some things are perfect because they're crooked.

title: POV: you're dating a Sagittarius.
caption: Ask a Sagittarius and you get the honest answer. About your hat, their cooking, and how much they like you.

title: Sagittarius' holidays
caption: 2016 Sag sent a summit selfie to the family dinner and left an empty chair. 2026 Sag walks in with snowy boots, a bag of stories and someone new to meet. Which one is your Sag this year?

title: Date 1 with a Water sign: what to ask
caption: Asking about their last relationship on date one can close a door before it opens. Ask who makes them feel at home instead, and listen longer than feels natural.

title: Drew Your Crush
caption:
Gift exchange, and you drew your crush.
Skip the big spend and the mystery pen. Get the thing they mentioned once. It shows you listened.

title: The Taurus Nests
caption: Observed in the cold months: a Taurus gathering every blanket in the house and guarding the snacks with one eye open. The rare part is the sharing, and it was caught on film.

title: They're always late and it bugs me.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/14 - They're always late and it bugs me. (naske14).mp4
caption: Name the feeling, not the flaw. "I feel forgotten when I wait" lands softer than a label. Then pick a time that works for you both.

title: Sagittarius plans a pottery class
caption:
A pottery class with zero experience: cute or chaos?
Two lopsided mugs, swapped and loved. Making something badly together counts.

title: Celebrates your small wins
caption: One new leaf on a houseplant and Sagittarius threw a full parade. Get you someone who brings a banner to your tiny wins. What small win deserves confetti this week?

title: Libra's holiday blind spot
caption: Two families, one night, and you said yes to both. Libra, you can't please everyone at once. Choose one, say so kindly and plan the other for another day.

title: One blanket left
caption:
Snowed in at the café with the whole street, and one blanket left for you two.
Moonlight Lane, Ep 5.

title: The Gemini in the Wild
caption: Here we see the Gemini, keeping three conversations in the air at once. Its call: wait, what? And then, very rarely, it lands and listens. Narrated as quietly as possible.

title: Out of Office
caption: Still answering work messages at the holiday table? Set the auto-reply and trust it. The work will wait for you, and the people beside you are only here for a little while.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Libra at the holiday party
caption:
Four outfit changes before leaving for one party.
Worth it, because Libra arrives and introduces the two people who were meant to be friends.

title: Virgo Needs Advice
caption: Virgo always has the answer, until the crush is Virgo's. The chat answered with Virgo's own advice, word for word. Who gives your chat its best advice?

title: What if my chart has no fire?
caption: Counted your chart and found an element missing? It doesn't mean something is broken. Skills can be learned, and you don't need a partner to complete you. You arrive whole.

title: Who handles their partner's bad day better?
caption:
Your person is having a rough day. Blanket fort, or one simple question first?
Advice or a hug? Ask, then give that.

title: The Cancer Hosts
caption: The Cancer builds a shell of pillows and feeds every visitor. Every one. What the cameras almost never catch: someone bringing the Cancer a cookie for once. Who hosts your friend group?

title: Scorpio × Aquarius: the vault and the open door.
caption: Sharing good news is lovely; asking first is lovelier. Check before you tell the group, share one small secret when you're ready, and keep something just for the two of you.

title: Leo rehearses the party entrance
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/3 AM in Winter/05 - Leo rehearses the party entrance (n3ae05).mp4
caption:
Rehearsing your party entrance at 3 AM?
Skip the big moment. Walk over and say hi.

title: Calgary: the chinook crush
caption: Aquarius was not ready for a warm wind in the middle of winter, or for feelings. Some things thaw fast. Which sign gets the weirdest when they like someone?

title: Move it off the screen.
caption: Late-night fights over text go sideways because tone doesn't come through. Ask to talk tomorrow, face to face. A short "ok." sounds very different with a smile attached.

title: Winter starter pack: Leo
caption:
Leo's coat is an event and the holiday photo took 40 tries.
Best part? They make room in the frame for the shy one.

title: Gemini vs Sagittarius: Yes or Yes
caption:
"Yes or yes?" is not a question, Sagittarius. Gemini took the round by asking about the homebody's favorite night in.
Are you the plan-maker or the plan-joiner?

title: You Can Cover, Right?
caption: Being single doesn't make your time spare. Your plans count, even the solo ones. You can still help out on your terms by offering a day that works for you.

title: You said it once
caption:
Why does your Capricorn keep writing in that notebook?
Every little thing you mentioned once. Remembered.

title: Aquarius invents a heated bench
caption: Aquarius built a heated bench to solve winter for everyone, when it mostly wanted one person to sit down. And then the first snow showed up. What would you invent to avoid saying it out loud?

title: When a friend is in a new relationship
caption: A friend in love can disappear for a while. "You've changed" pushes them away; "we miss you" invites them back. Say it warmly, and leave room for the new person too.

title: A pop-up card
caption:
Aquarius reviews a handmade pop-up card. No talking allowed.
The engineering impressed. The message inside won.

title: The Scrapbook
caption: A whole month of Sag in one scrapbook: the packing list, the toast, the party of forty. And someone with a planner is peeking at the next page. Favorite Sag moment?

title: I keep changing my mind about them.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/15 - I keep changing my mind about them. (naske15).mp4
caption: Mixed feelings are information, not failure. Write down what you like and what you are unsure about, then tell them gently where you are.

title: Pisces cries about a blind card
caption: Their blind card says they cry at weddings. And bakeries. Pisces may have found their person. Card first, face last.

title: The Sagittarius Roams
caption: Pacing at dawn. Bolting after a new idea. And then, rarely seen, coming back with a second backpack for someone. The wild Sagittarius in its natural habitat.

title: Scorpio's holiday blind spot
caption: Scorpio, not every gift tag is a clue. Sometimes a mug really is just a mug. If you're wondering what something meant, ask them. Don't try to decode it.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Scorpio at the holiday party
caption:
Has a Scorpio ever skipped hello and asked what scares you?
It really listens to the answer. Maybe open with the weather, though.

title: Taurus Replied to Monday
caption: Taurus answered Monday's soup question on Thursday, and meant it. Then kept the usual date spot and added a new one. Which sign replies four days later?

title: Date 2 with a Water sign: reading it
caption: If they shared one small true thing, that matters more than you might think. Don't push for the whole story. Notice the opening and keep it safe.

title: Who overthinks the text
caption:
Who rewrites "hi" for an hour before sending it?
The signs, ranked by overthinking. When in doubt, just ask them.

title: Asks before posting your photo
caption: Capricorn asked before posting, deleted the blinky one on request, and Leo got the good angle. Consent includes the camera roll. Which friend has your approval on photos?

title: It's a Gift Swap, Not a Final
caption: Gift swaps get competitive fast. The best part was never the prize: it's laughing together when the plan falls apart. Play to have fun, and let the candle go.

title: Joking it off
caption:
Do you crack a joke whenever a moment gets real?
Sagittarius does. Moonlight Lane, Ep 5.

title: The Libra Decides
caption: Two menus. Forty minutes. A poll of the entire herd, split evenly. Then someone asks what the Libra wants, and it answers instantly. Be the person who asks.

title: How does each mode handle a fight?
caption: Do you always just agree to end the argument? A good disagreement needs three moves: bring it up kindly, hold on to your values and stay flexible on the details. Save this for the next hard talk.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Sagittarius at the holiday party
caption:
Late, snowy, and already telling the story of the bus ride.
Sagittarius wants a snow walk right now, and asks who wants in.

title: Capricorn's holidays
caption: Capricorn said after this email four times and missed the whole holiday party. This year the laptop got a sticky note and Capricorn got a dance floor. Badly, on purpose.

title: Libra × Taurus: two Venus signs, one dessert.
caption: Agreeing on most things still leaves room for small standoffs. Make the little decision, share the last bite, and when in doubt, order two desserts.

title: They go to bed at 9:30.
caption:
They're asleep by 9:30 every night. Dealbreaker for a night owl?
Not at all. Early sleepers make the best breakfast dates.

title: First scarf day
caption:
Leo walked out in slow motion for the first scarf of winter. The scarf had other plans, and so did Libra.
Who in your life would happily share a scarf?

title: Sagittarius' holiday blind spot
caption: Sagittarius, your holiday trip isn't the problem. Telling them the night before is. Share your dates early because they care where you'll be. And send a postcard.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Capricorn at the holiday party
caption:
Capricorn planned to leave at 9:30.
It's the last one there, doing the dishes, because it wants to.

title: Aries vs Leo: The Main Event
caption:
Aries changed its mind mid-argument on live TV. Leo threw a party for someone else. Character growth all around, and the scoreboard split it down the middle.
Who needs the bigger stage in your friend group?

title: They're away for the holidays. I miss them.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/16 - They're away for the holidays. I miss them. (naske16).mp4
caption: Missing someone means it matters. Plan one call you both look forward to, and lean on the people who are right here with you.

title: Capricorn, when they ask how your day was
caption:
Capricorn, they asked about your day and you gave a full report.
Skip the chart. Tell them how it felt.

title: The window seat
caption:
Rain on the glass, deep thoughts, a whole movie in Cancer's head. Then the bus kept going.
Ever missed your stop and found something better?

title: Laugh with, not at.
caption: A joke too early can feel like a dodge when someone is still hurt. Talk first, then let the inside joke come back. Laughing together is the sweet part after you're heard.

title: POV: you're dating a Capricorn.
caption: Your Capricorn arrives early with your coffee and a five-year plan for the houseplant. Year five? Still you.

title: Winnipeg: tears that sparkle
caption: It's so cold here that Pisces' tears come out as glitter, and honestly it's a look. A spare mitten helps too. Which sign cries at the first snowfall?

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Snowed In
caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 5: the whole lane is snowed in at the café, a talk card goes round, and Sagittarius answers with a fun fact. When a moment gets real, try staying in it instead of joking your way out.

title: Happy Holidays, Ex
caption:
Your ex texts "happy holidays." Essay or silence?
A short, kind reply is fine. So is no reply. Both are allowed.

title: Pisces cries at the first snow
caption: Pisces cried at a snowflake, then a snowman, then deleted a two-word text. The snow got a reply before Pisces did. What's the text you keep typing and never sending?

title: The Friend Dinner
caption: No date this year, and a table full of friends instead. Friendship is a real kind of love. Save this for whoever's hosting your friend dinner.

title: Capricorn plans a sunrise hike
caption:
Would you hike at 5 AM to see the sunrise?
Capricorn timed every step, then put the watch away when the sun came up.

title: Sag Was Honest. Very.
caption: Sag told a date the dinner was a bit salty. True, but the chat had notes: lead with what you loved. Ever been honest a little too fast?

title: The tiny check-in
caption: No energy for a paragraph? You don't need one. A ten-second voice note or one honest line still tells your friends you're here. Small check-ins count.

title: Who handles running late better?
caption:
Running late to a date: text the second you know, or turn the detour into an adventure?
A quick heads-up is the kind move.

title: The dropped book
caption:
Gemini dropped the book for the big meet-cute. Virgo reached for it with their own title card ready.
Two main characters, one café. Who gets top billing?

title: Guests in Ten Minutes
caption:
Hosting doesn't mean doing it all yourself. When guests offer to help, say yes: most people love having a small job. A kitchen full of friends is the whole point.
Save this for your next dinner.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Aquarius at the holiday party
caption:
Spent an hour at the party talking to the host's dog?
Aquarius gets it. Then it starts a snowflake table where every weird one is perfect.

title: Remembers your friends' names
caption: Rosa, Dev and Kit were not ready for Aquarius to remember their names AND their trip. Instant friend-group approval. Who passed the name test with your people?

title: Capricorn's holiday blind spot
caption: "Just one email" can eat a whole holiday, Capricorn. The work will still be there tomorrow. They miss you, so close the laptop and play the game.

title: A fact when it gets real
caption:
'You always do a fact when it gets real.'
Why deflecting keeps people out. Moonlight Lane, Ep 5.

title: Catching the train
caption:
Sagittarius sprinted for the last train like the credits were rolling. The doors had opinions. Aquarius did not let them win.
Who holds the door for you?

title: Date 3 with a Water sign: saying what you want
caption: Hoping they'll just know how you feel puts the whole job on them. Say it gently, then ask how they're feeling. Soft and clear is still brave. Save this for date three.

title: Who falls the fastest
caption:
Which sign falls the fastest? One of them fell at hello.
Ranked from instant to slow and steady. Your pace is the right pace.

title: Aquarius' holidays
caption: Aquarius threw an anti-holiday party around a cactus in 2016 and confused every guest. Same cactus now, plus lights, two stockings and someone who thinks it is perfect. Weird lasts when it is shared.

title: What is the winter solstice?
caption: Dark by late afternoon? The solstice is the longest night of the year in the north, and the light comes back a little every day after it. On long nights, reach out to the people who warm you.

title: They read your phone over your shoulder.
caption:
They read your messages over your shoulder. Harmless, or not okay?
Not okay. Trust doesn't peek, and you're allowed your privacy.

title: Tears in the snow
caption:
Pisces wanted one perfect tear in the first snow. It froze and went clink. Scorpio showed up with a tissue and cocoa anyway.
Tag the friend who brings the cocoa.

title: Virgo × Leo: the helper and the headliner.
caption: Quiet care deserves to be noticed out loud. Take the thank-you when it comes, notice the small things your person does, and give the helper a moment in the light.

title: Aquarius, when they say "I missed you"
caption:
Aquarius, still buffering after they said "I missed you"?
You missed them too. Say it back.

title: Cancer vs Capricorn: Soup or Steps
caption:
One sign brings soup, one brings a five-step plan. Capricorn won by saying "I missed you" out loud, then blushed.
Soup person or plan person: which do you need on a bad day?

title: They're shy. I'm... not.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/17 - They're shy. I'm... not. (naske17).mp4
caption: Shy is not uninterested; it is a pace. Ask, then wait a beat longer than usual. A quiet walk can say more than a loud party.

title: POV: you're dating an Aquarius.
caption: An Aquarius won't buy you a gift. They'll build one that pours cocoa very slowly. Weird and sweet is the point.

title: A first date, explained badly
caption:
Virgo's whiteboard breakdown of a first date: two strangers, one table, snacks, and two people insisting they're chill.
What would you add to the diagram?

title: Aquarius' holiday blind spot
caption: Going quiet at a big family dinner doesn't make you weird, Aquarius. You're watching. When you're ready, pick one person and ask one question. It opens the whole room.

title: The Skating Date
caption:
Ice skating date, and you can't skate.
No faking it, no dodging it. Say you're new at this and hold the wall together.

title: Quebec City: two walls, one gate
caption: Cancer and Capricorn found a whole city built like them: walls everywhere. Then the maple taffy came out and one gate opened. Which two signs need this trip?

title: Delayed. Again.
caption: Travel delays can leave you apologising to everyone, even the departure board. A delay isn't your fault. Send one kind update home, find a snack, and let yourself rest.

title: Aquarius plans a thrift-shop challenge
caption:
You dress each other from the thrift shop. Who wins?
The cape, the feather hat and one moon boot, worn with pride.

title: The double date
caption: One couple skates in perfect sync with matching mugs. The other apologised three times in ten seconds. Fun fact: the smooth ones started with someone in a fountain. Which pair is your group chat?

title: Plan the next one calm.
caption: The best time to plan how you make up is on a calm day. Pick a pause word, agree how long, and how you come back. Which word would you two pick?

title: Who handles a surprise video call better?
caption:
Surprise video call. Do you answer in the dark or mid-experiment in goggles?
They called to see you, messy hair and all.

title: Scorpio Asked Everyone
caption: Scorpio asked everyone what makes their day better, totally not because of the gift exchange. Your turn: what small thing makes yours?

title: Movie Night for One
caption: Crying at a movie, alone, under a blanket, and loving every minute. Feeling things on your own still counts. Your own company can be the coziest plan.

series: Your Sign at the Holiday Party
title: Pisces at the holiday party
caption:
Cried in the group photo. Hugged the host goodbye for twenty minutes.
Pisces at a party, and honestly, the big feelings are welcome.

title: A crush, explained badly
caption:
Capricorn explains a crush with a marker and zero chill: a tab opens in your brain and it simply never closes.
How long have you re-read one text?

title: Boundaries with friends
caption: You can love someone and still not have anything left at 1 AM. A boundary is care for both of you. Say the no, offer the next yes, and show up rested.

title: Virgo's 3 AM pros and cons
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/3 AM in Winter/06 - Virgo's 3 AM pros and cons (n3ae06).mp4
caption:
Long list of pros, and the only con is that you're scared?
Scared isn't a con. It means it matters.

title: Checks in when you go quiet
caption: No pressure to reply, just here when you need me. Pisces sent the kindest text and then cried at it, naturally. Who do you text first when you've been quiet a while?

title: Why do same-element signs make a triangle?
caption: Same-element signs sit 120 degrees apart on the wheel, which is why they form triangles. Easy connection feels lovely, but the people who aren't like you often help you grow the most.

title: Moonlight Lane teaser: the map
caption:
Ever made a gift that says a little too much?
Cancer drew Sagittarius. This is not a small gift.

title: Cuffing season, explained badly
caption:
Aquarius explains cuffing season with penguins, which honestly tracks. The blanket is optional. The person is the point.
Team blanket or team person?

title: Pisces × Sagittarius: the dream and the dare.
caption: Big dreams feel safer when you're not rushing them. Slow the dare to someday, say what you need tonight, and plan one dream a year together. Save this for your planning night.

title: Winter starter pack: Virgo
caption:
Virgo's gift list has tabs and the wrapping is perfect.
They also noticed your gloves were thin, and fixed it.

title: Taurus vs Virgo: Snack Diplomacy
caption:
Taurus showed up eating. Virgo walked into a messy apartment and did not clean it, which deserves its own trophy.
Be honest: would you have cleaned it?

title: I can't stop noticing their flaws.
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/18 - I can't stop noticing their flaws. (naske18).mp4
caption: Noticing is a gift; judging is a choice. Write down three things you love about them too. Nobody is perfect, and that is the good part.

title: Baked your sign
caption:
Waiting all evening while someone kneads the same dough?
Worth it when the bread comes out shaped like your sign.

title: Meeting the parents, explained badly
caption:
Gemini says meeting the parents is a job interview with lasagna and your baby photos on a slideshow. Then the twist: they're nervous too.
What did you bring the first time?
