Capricorn, they gave you a gift and you're already doing the math.
It isn't a bill. "Thank you" is enough.

title: Leo vs Aquarius: Same Story Twice
caption: Your date tells the same story twice. Leo offers a better story, about Leo. Aquarius just laughs again. Who's the Aquarius in your life?

title: Aquarius: one word for the new year
caption: Aquarius, your word for next year is warm. Keep the cool, clear mind. Let people see the warm heart under it too.

title: POV: you're dating a Capricorn. The card.
caption: A Capricorn gives you the most practical gift ever made. The card that came with it took six drafts.

title: Forwarded
caption: Pisces forwarded their date's voice note, too emotional to hear it twice. Scorpio played it: a made-up song that rhymes Pisces with nice is. Saying what it meant took one second. Who sends the voice notes?

title: What's your 3rd house?
caption: Your 3rd house, in astrology: siblings, neighbours, everyday talk and short trips. Love doesn't only live in big moments. A text to your sibling or a wave next door counts too.

title: The Longest Night
caption:
The longest night of the year. Confess everything or go stargaze alone?
A long night is good for a long talk. Pull a talk card and take turns.

title: Pisces at the Puppy Party
caption: Pisces cried at a puppy's birthday and had receipts: the tiny hat, the singing, and being called "my person." By the end, everyone was crying. Valid, right?

title: The New Year's plan
caption: Wanting a big night when your person wants pajamas isn't a problem to win. Say what you really want, find the overlap, and build a plan you both actually like.

title: Capricorn plans a goals whiteboard
caption:
A date where you plan your goals on a whiteboard?
Their date added "dance in the kitchen" and Capricorn circled it twice.

title: They Remembered Her Name
caption: Mentioned your sister once, three weeks ago. They asked about her new job by name. Taurus has never recovered. What's the smallest thing that won you over?

title: The Family Photo
caption: Not sure if you belong in their family photo? Just ask. "In or out?" is a kind question, and either answer is fine. Send this to someone meeting the family this year.

title: Who handles meeting their pet better?
caption:
Meeting their pet for the first time: a hand-knitted sweater, or straight to fetch?
Kindness to what they love says a lot.

title: The quiet walk after dinner
caption: The house hit max volume, so Scorpio and Pisces went for a walk under Orion and finally said the nervous part out loud. Pisces cried, obviously. Where do you have your best talks?

title: Sagittarius: what I'm keeping
caption: A joke is a great way to start a hard conversation and a hard way to finish one. Keep the honesty, drop the maybe-plans, and say the real thing first.

title: Meeting the friends: then vs now
caption: Hiding your date behind the coat rack, or saying "this is Libra" and watching your friends make room. Your people want to know.

title: Take Your Time
caption: Libra holding two menus like a life decision, and the date just leans back: no rush. Some people are built different. Which sign needs this patience the most?

title: Scorpio × Sagittarius: the haircut review.
caption: Blunt words can sting even when they're meant kindly. Be honest and gentle, say when something hurts instead of storing it, and trade one compliment a day.

title: Who gets the most excited for snow
caption:
Who's outside before the first snowflake lands?
All twelve signs, ranked by snow joy. Find someone that excited to see you.

title: Whose family?
caption: 2016 was the holiday tug-of-war: two dinners, two desserts, late to both. 2026 is a sticky note on the fridge with lunch, dinner and a walk home that belongs to just you two. How do you split the day?

title: Pisces: how you love in winter
caption: Pisces, one glance and you've planned a whole winter together. Daydreams are lovely, but the real person in front of you is even better. Go say hi.

title: Ice skating: then vs now
caption: Wobbling across the ice insisting you're a natural, or asking "teach me?" and holding hands. Saying teach me is flirting.

title: Anchorage: the crier
caption: Pisces cried at the sunset, a moose and one snowflake, in that order. Then Scorpio showed up with a tissue and started crying too. That's the whole love story. Who cries with you?

title: Should I wait for them to change?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/34 - Should I wait for them to change- (naske34).mp4
caption: Hoping someone will change? Give it time, but not forever. Watch what they do more than what they promise, and remember that your time matters too.

title: They brought a documentary to movie night.
caption:
Movie night, and they brought a documentary about moss. Dealbreaker?
Weird is a gift. Watch theirs, then they watch yours.

title: Cap Says One Yes
caption: Four party invites. Capricorn picks one, shows up on time with a gift and actually listens. Are you a one-party or an every-party person?

title: Let it rest
caption: Once a hurt has been talked through and forgiven, try not to bring it back as a joke. Let mended things rest, and make some new inside jokes instead.

title: Aquarius, when they remember your fun fact
caption:
Aquarius, they remembered your octopus fact. Three hearts.
Someone was listening. Let that feel good.

title: Gemini vs Aquarius: Silence Is Allowed
caption: Your date goes quiet and Gemini has fun facts ready. All of them. Aquarius just sits with them. Are you a fun facts person or a sit-in-silence person?

title: Curious Again
caption: Happy on your own and starting to feel curious? That's a good sign. Ready feels like curious, not lonely. Go slow and let the conversation come first.

title: POV: you're dating an Aquarius. New Year's.
caption: An Aquarius celebrates midnight every hour from 7 PM. By your actual midnight they're asleep on your shoulder.

title: Dietary needs
caption: Cancer asked for dietary needs and got yes, spicy, something new and a spreadsheet. The real question: their partner's family recipe. Virgo: ask them to teach you. Who in your chat would try the surprise anyway?

title: After the holidays
caption: The quiet days after the holidays can be harder than the holidays themselves. Check in after too: how are you doing now that it's quiet? Someone will be glad you asked.

title: Crush in Town
caption:
Your crush is in town for the holidays.
Don't plan their whole trip, and don't just wait. Text "free for cocoa?" and keep it simple.

title: The call to a friend who stayed in town
caption: Virgo called the friend who stayed in the city, the whole family crowded in to wave, and Grandma had questions about dinner. A plate is officially saved. Who are you calling this holiday?

title: The Drive Home
caption: On the drive home from their family's, start with three things you genuinely liked. Then share one honest thing, gently. Their family, their call.

title: Aquarius plans a time capsule
caption:
Make a time capsule together and open it next winter.
A spoon, a ticket, a duck and two notes for future you.

title: Home Safe?
caption: "home safe?" and then they actually wait up for the answer. Sagittarius pretends to be cool about it. Sagittarius is not cool about it. Who checks in on you?

title: Capricorn: what I'm keeping
caption: Feelings don't fit neatly on a schedule, and they don't need to. Keep the steady promises you're known for, and make room for dinner, and for the heart, without a deadline.

title: Who handles the holiday photo better?
caption:
Holiday photos: twelve more for your good side, or crying at how cute it came out?
Get in the picture. You'll be glad later.

title: Bragging Out Loud
caption: When their friends say "FINALLY" because they've heard all about you already. Virgo, blushing in real time. Tag someone who brags about the people they love.

title: Pisces: the holiday blind spot
caption: Pisces feels everyone's feelings at the holidays and carries them all. You can care deeply without holding it all yourself. Hand some of it back.

title: New Year’s plans: then vs now
caption: Waiting by a silent phone on the 31st, or asking first: "be my New Year's plan?" Asking first is brave. And cute.

title: The snow day
caption: Aquarius watched the 2016 snow day through the window and texted cute snow. In 2026 it went out and helped build the most lopsided snow-star on the block. Cold hands. Totally worth it.

title: What's your 4th house?
caption: In astrology, the 4th house sits at the very bottom of your chart: home, family and roots. Family can be the one you're born into and the one you build. This month, hold your boundaries kindly.

title: Pisces gets a 3 AM text from a friend
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/3 AM in Winter/12 - Pisces gets a 3 AM text from a friend (n3ae12).mp4
caption:
Awake at 3 AM, and it turns out a friend is too.
Long nights are easier together. Check on your people.

title: Excited About Your Thing
caption: Aquarius shows off the rock collection and the date asks to see the sparkly one again. That's the whole review. What's your thing people should get excited about?

title: The year-end check-in
caption: Before the year ends, try three questions together: your favourite moment, what was hard, and what you want more of. Listen to the hard one gently. Save this for a cozy night in.

title: Winter starter pack: Pisces
caption:
Pisces in winter: a window seat, soft tissues, one song on repeat.
The rare item: happy tears because someone remembered.

title: Leaving early, kindly
caption: Option one was vanishing. Option two was a forty-minute goodbye in the doorway. Capricorn picked option three and left with a tower of leftovers. How do you leave a party early?

title: Aquarius × Virgo: Snow Tuesday.
caption: A big new idea can meet a lot of edits. Cheer the first draft, take the one good note, and build the thing together. What's your made-up holiday?

title: In snow, holding hands
caption:
Why is Pisces lying in the snow, crying?
Two snow angels, holding hands. Happy tears count.

title: Choose Your Party Plus-One
caption: Leo works the room, Virgo has a backup gift, and Pisces cries at the toast. The cursor knew what it wanted. Who's your pick for the holiday party?

title: Can we skip the usual holiday stuff?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/35 - Can we skip the usual holiday stuff- (naske35).mp4
caption: Skipping the usual holiday plans is allowed. Make a tradition that feels like yours, like pancakes at midnight or a walk in the snow, and let family know early and kindly.

title: A jar of twelve reasons
caption:
Pisces tries to review a jar of twelve reasons without crying.
It made it to reason one. Twelve out of ten.

title: Ottawa: your pace
caption: Gemini lapped Taurus three times on the frozen canal without stopping talking once. Then they slowed down and listened. Are you the zoomer or the steady skater?

title: The Thank-You Text
caption: After a visit, thank their parents within a day. Use their name and mention one real moment. Small, specific thanks are the ones people keep.

title: Pisces cries about you
caption: Yes, you. You texted back, said sorry first and stayed kind this year. Pisces noticed. Feeling it all is its own courage.

title: Cap's Snow Day
caption: Capricorn's plans got snowed in, so it drew a blueprint for a snowman. The lumpy one still made the photo. Best day you never planned?

title: Aquarius: what I'm keeping
caption: Going quiet when someone gets close can look like not caring, even when you care a lot. Keep your wonderful ideas, and let the right people in a little closer this year.

title: Who loves the hardest
caption:
We tried to rank who loves the hardest. It didn't go to plan.
Every sign loves hard, just differently.

title: Virgo vs Pisces: The Spare Key
caption: Pisces cried for them. Virgo showed up with the spare key and a snack. Rematch settled. Who's your spare-key friend?

title: Pisces: the gift that means the most
caption: Pisces doesn't need anything expensive. A few honest lines in someone's own handwriting will be kept for years. If you love a Pisces, write it down.

title: They already bought matching mittens.
caption:
They already bought you matching mittens. Too soon?
Warm hands, warm heart. Put them on.

title: Best moment
caption: Leo asked for everyone's best moment of the year and the chat brought callbacks. Aries said it was a bad year for love. Virgo said learning what you want counts. What did your year teach you?

title: Thank them for staying
caption: Before the year ends, tell your person what they did right when things got hard. Staying kind in a fight deserves a thank you. Who are you thanking tonight?

title: Pisces, when your holiday card is three pages
caption:
Pisces, is your holiday card on page four yet?
Big feelings are a gift. Send it.

title: Choose Your Road-Trip Co-Pilot
caption: Sagittarius has a "shortcut," Capricorn printed the route twice, and Cancer packed your snacks with labels. Pick your co-pilot. Comments are open.

title: The Thriving Party
caption: Single isn't a waiting room. It's a life, and it's worth celebrating out loud. Tag the friends who'd be first through the door at your thriving party.

title: POV: you're dating a Pisces. The gift.
caption: A Pisces cries wrapping your gift and cries handing it over. Then you open it, and now you're both crying.

title: Choose Your First-Date Planner
caption: Aries picked the place four minutes ago. Taurus booked the comfy booth. Scorpio found somewhere you can actually hear each other. Which planner are you?

title: The year's last friends' night
caption: A year of small check-ins adds up to this: the whole group in one room, and one more on the call. Thank you for being someone's friend first. Who are you sending this to?

title: They Planned Everything
caption:
They planned the whole winter date. How do you thank them?
Not by out-planning them. Tell them what you loved about it.

title: The drive home debrief
caption: The drive home: one hard part, one best part, and a recipe card from Grandma that nearly made Leo miss the turn. What's the first thing you ask each other on the way home?

title: What's your 11th house?
caption: Astrologers read the 11th house as friends, community, and hopes and wishes. Friends are a love story too, so tell them. If you have a wish for the new year, say it out loud to a friend, then ask for theirs.

title: Pisces plans letters out loud
caption:
Write each other letters, then read them out loud.
Pisces wrote nine pages. Their date wrote two lines. Both cried.

title: Choose Your Bad-Day Person
caption: One fun fact from Aquarius, two desserts from Libra, and then a second player joins: you, showing up for them too. Who's your bad-day person?

title: You made it
caption: If the holidays left you tired, you're not doing it wrong. You held boundaries, asked for help, and were gentle with yourself. Rest is allowed, and you made it.

title: Who handles the countdown better?
caption:
The countdown to midnight: run it to the second, or make a quiet wish together?
Whatever the clock says, be with your people.

title: The holiday wish
caption: Pisces made one wish at the window in 2016: someone to spend the holidays with. Ten years later the table is full, the same star winks back, and yes, Pisces is crying again. Who is at your table this year?

title: Aries × Leo: two fires, one tree.
caption: Two people who both love to go first. Let them shine, cheer their wins, and make room for both of you at the top.

title: Holiday leftovers: then vs now
caption: Guarding the leftovers behind a breadstick fence, or packing a box labelled "for you." Love sometimes looks like leftovers.

title: Helsinki: when the snow settles
caption: Taurus waited for the snow to settle before saying hi. The stars kept shaking the globe. That's the season finale and the point: there's never a perfectly still moment. Who are you waiting to say hi to?

title: How do I know it's real this time?
drive_file: Star Talk/Next 30 days - 29 Nov to 28 Dec/Ask the Stars, Volume 2/36 - How do I know it's real this time- (naske36).mp4
caption: Real love often feels calmer than the movies. It shows up on ordinary days, and you get to feel like yourself around them. If that sounds familiar, hold on to it gently.

title: Cap's Year in Love
caption: Capricorn's year in love, in slides. Say how I feel: done, once. Rest: working on it. Then Sag showed up with a review of its own. What's your goal for next year?

title: Our Own Tradition
caption: After all the visits, ask what the two of you want to keep. Keep what felt like home, gently let go of what didn't, and start one tradition that's just yours. What would yours be?

title: Cancer vs Pisces: Finale
caption: Finale night: Cancer vs Pisces, two podiums, zero dry eyes. Last question, and they both just hugged. Which sign cried hardest at your last goodbye?

title: Pisces: what I'm keeping
caption: Loving someone's potential is not the same as loving who they are right now. Keep your soft heart, stop apologising for your feelings, and carry them a little braver.

title: Why so quiet?
caption: The group chat went quiet for hours. Pisces got worried. Everyone was at the same table, Pisces included. The bread burnt and nobody cared. Who would you put down your phone for?

title: Pisces: one word for the new year
caption: Pisces, your word for next year is ground. Keep dreaming, just with your feet in the snow. A dream with roots is one you can actually live.

title: Where we're going next year
caption: Split the days, take turns, one very long table, or all twelve families in one day. The finale lands where it should: you pick it together. So where are you two going next year?

title: Choose Your Cuffing-Season Character
caption: Gemini has two plans in one night, Capricorn has a five-year plan by date two, and the cursor picks the mirror. Who are you choosing this winter?
